requirements.statement: A user can sign in securely so their todo list is private and persists across sessions

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is prompted to sign in before seeing any todo list
After signing in, a user sees only their own todo items, never another user's
A signed-in user's todo list is still present after signing out and signing back in

requirements.statement: A user can add a todo item with a title

criteria.must: Submitting a title creates a new todo item visible in the user's list
Attempting to add a todo item with an empty title is rejected

requirements.statement: A user can view their list of todo items

criteria.must: The todo list screen displays every todo item belonging to the signed-in user
Each listed todo item shows its title and its done/not-done status

requirements.statement: A user can mark a todo item as done or not-done

criteria.must: Marking an open todo item done updates its displayed status to done
Marking a done todo item not-done updates its displayed status back to open

requirements.statement: A user can delete a todo item

criteria.must: Deleting a todo item removes it from the user's list
A deleted todo item does not reappear after reloading the list
